from jinja2.sandbox import SandboxedEnvironment, SecurityError
import pytest

EXPECTED_SYMPTOM = {
    "exception_type": "SecurityError",
    "message_regex": "access to attribute .* is unsafe",
    "description": "Jinja SandboxedEnvironment access to unsafe attribute format_map",
    "target_symbols": ["jinja2.sandbox.SandboxedEnvironment.is_safe_attribute"],
}

def test_reproduce_issue():
    env = SandboxedEnvironment()
    tmpl = env.from_string("{{ ''.format_map }}")
    tmpl.render()
